name: The Music of Morricone, Zimmer & Williams
description: This concert pays tribute to film composers Ennio Morricone, Hans Zimmer, and John Williams. The Royal Film Concert Orchestra performs well-known film soundtracks.
longDescription:
The Coliseu Porto Ageas hosts "The Music of Morricone, Zimmer & Williams" on November 22, 2026, at 16:30. The Royal Film Concert Orchestra performs a selection of famous film scores by Ennio Morricone, Hans Zimmer, and John Williams.

The program includes music from films such as "Piratas das Caraíbas," "O Bom, O Mau e O Vilão," "O Rei Leão," "Gladiador," "Parque Jurássico," "Harry Potter," and "Star Wars." The event is suitable for ages six and up.

Tickets range from €30 for Galeria seats to €300 for a Camarote de 1ª (6 lugares). Other prices include €65 for Cadeira de Orquestra, €55 for 1ª Plateia, €45 for 2ª Plateia, €50 for Tribuna, and €35 for Balcão Popular. For information on accessibility tickets, contact the Coliseu Porto Ageas box office.
